name: IOF 2.0
description: The IOF brand (IOF Brand Book) in the language of top-level sports TV: white plates with IOF Green table headers and rows in white and the 20 % tint, Franklin Gothic Heavy headings in IOF Blue, the red-over-green LINES, the white-green-blue pattern with the negative IOF logo, an F1-style timing tower, a scorebug clock and fast wipes.
author: Split Control, after the IOF broadcast graphics guidelines
fonts: Libre Franklin (OFL) stands in for Franklin Gothic Heavy and Book
